dimensionality_and_embedding_audit.finding: Scalar characteristic frequency differences d_ij = |f_i - f_j| generate a distance matrix whose Gram matrix has exact Rank 1 (100.0% variance in 1D, 0.0% in 2D and 3D; Cayley-Menger tetrahedral volume = 0). Attempting to embed a 3x3x3 3D cube using scalar frequencies yields catastrophic distortion (Kruskal Stress-1 = 0.479); adding variable spectral widths (f_i, sigma_i) only reaches a 2D manifold (Stress-1 = 0.221). Recovering 3D space requires replacing scalar frequency with a 3-vector or fine-tuning an interaction graph to a 3D lattice a priori.

kinematic_and_identity_degeneracy_audit.finding: Associating momentum with 'resistance to frequency change' (F = gamma * df/dt) yields overdamped Aristotelian mechanics where bodies stop immediately when external force ceases (post-pulse velocity = 0.0 vs Newtonian 2.0). Furthermore, mapping spatial position to scalar frequency x = Phi(f) creates an insoluble trilemma between position, velocity (df/dt), and internal rest-mass/atomic frequency: two identical atoms at different positions must have different frequencies, while a proton and electron at the same position must have the same frequency.
